body:
## Outcome

Use Bloxwap Sans, Mono, and intentional Pixel accents consistently while preserving language support and native text scaling.

Roadmap: #1 · Milestone: M1: Foundations and architecture · Priority: P0 (required for v1).

## Scope

- Consume @bloxwap/font as the font asset source. Define Sans for interface/prose, Mono for code and numeric roles where appropriate, and scoped Pixel use.
- Specify type roles, weight, line height, tracking, tabular figures, locale fallback, truncation, and numeric formatting; derive scales from existing products.
- Document web CSS and Next.js loading plus native TTF/static face generation and registration with explicit family/weight mappings, licensing, and provenance.
- Resolve the existing web rem versus RN dp/NativeWind rem-root difference deliberately; do not enlarge all native text by mechanically renaming existing steps.
- Support Dynamic Type/font scaling and the applicable Arabic/Hebrew/Asian and other published companion families. Load only the required font families/scripts.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] React and RN samples show the approved type roles with predictable weight/line-height mapping and no system-font substitutions caused by invalid family names.
- [ ] Recorded checks cover large text, long translations, mixed scripts, RTL, code ligatures, and tabular numeric alignment.
- [ ] Font assets come from a pinned source/version and generation process; package/install documentation avoids per-repo binary copies.
- [ ] Fallback loading and font subset/loading budgets are documented and verified without clipping or avoidable layout shifts.

## Prerequisites

- #5 — Bootstrap the HIG workspace and runnable web/native consumer fixtures

## References

- [Font](https://github.com/bloxwap/font/tree/main/apps/docs)
- [Tokens](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/packages/tokens)
- [Native](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/packages/ui-native)

## Completion evidence

Link implementation PRs, updated docs/examples, and relevant validation results. Record platform limitations and any remaining catalog/adoption work explicitly.
title: Integrate Bloxwap fonts and define cross-platform typography
